title: 第22章 锤炼元气第23章 连升三级
content_zh:
“不错！”
肖恩微微一笑，正是这个意思。
血拼，只会令到现在的百草堂覆灭，那不是他想看到的。
随着时间的流逝，烈日也在此时挂正了天空。
咔叽！
阳光折射下的赛台，此刻一座金字塔般的石台，正缓缓升起，一道道光流仿佛流转在周围，天地无尽元气汇聚，宛若潮汐流动。
嗡！
在那炼气台出现时，肖恩体内，不受控制的回荡着嗡鸣之声，似乎他体内的元气，仿佛有着一种被牵引而沸腾的迹象。
这种奇妙的感觉，让得肖恩愈发的期待着。
“这炼气台，其实争来也没有多大的意义，不过是能锤炼一下元气而已。”
“是啊，至今炼气台也没有人能够登上第五层的，那种锤炼效果，微乎其微！”
“鸡肋！”
而随着炼气台的升起，四周的人也是彼此交谈，但兴趣却不大。
这些声音，同样传入肖恩的耳中，不过，他只是报以淡淡的一笑。
微乎其微，那是因为没人能够得到真正的锤炼。
鸡肋？
三年开启一次，仅有四个名额，足以见得其珍贵之处。
不过，对于从来没有人能够登上第五级，他的脸上倒是荡漾着一种无可救药的自信。
因为，那是别人，而不是他！
“雅儿姐，记得我说的话没有？”肖恩望着乔雅，轻声道。

进入到了炼气台，相互之间就会看不见对方，但是可以感应到对方的位置，只是没法交流，这也是为了避免有人骚扰对方。
“嗯，记得了，傻弟弟。”
乔雅修长的睫毛微颤，一抹笑意荡漾在俏脸之上，肖恩为她准备得很周全。
天狼武馆走出来的，正是参加名额争夺战的当中两名聚元境九重的少年，此刻见到肖恩，都神情恭谨的上来抱拳问好。
肖恩随意的问了一声：“你们有没有什么准备？”
两名少年闻言，脸庞微微一红，神色尴尬：“这……”
他们手中这种普通的东西，在这个随便能够拿出极品元液的少年眼中，不知道算不算是准备？
“嗯！”
肖恩微微点头，抛出了两个玉瓶，然后道：“别上得太快了。”
说到这个份上，已经很不错了。
毕竟，肖恩也是仅凭一些推测，免得误人子弟。
“多谢，多谢小兄弟。”
content_en:
"Not bad!"
Sean smiled slightly, and that was exactly what he meant.
The bloody fight will only lead to the destruction of Baicaotang, which is not what he wants to see.
As time passed, the scorching sun also hung in the sky at this time.
Click!
Under the refraction of the sun, a pyramid-like stone platform is slowly rising on the stage. Light streams seem to be flowing around it, and the endless energy of heaven and earth gathers together, like a tidal flow.
Buzz!
When the Qi Refining Platform appeared, Sean's body was buzzing uncontrollably, as if the vitality in his body was being pulled and boiling.
This wonderful feeling made Sean look forward to it even more.
"This Qi refining platform actually doesn't have much meaning in fighting for it. It's just a way to temper your vitality."
"Yes, no one has been able to climb to the fifth level of the Qi Refining Platform so far. The effect of that kind of tempering is negligible!"
"Weak ribs!"
As the Qi Refining Platform rose, people around him also talked to each other, but they were not very interested.
These sounds also reached Sean's ears, but he just responded with a faint smile.
Very little, because no one can be truly tempered.
Tasteless?
It opens once every three years, and there are only four places available, which shows how valuable it is.
However, there was a hopeless confidence on his face as no one had ever been able to reach Level 5.
Because it was someone else, not him!
"Sister Ya'er, do you remember what I said?" Sean looked at Qiao Ya and said softly.
After entering the Qi Refining Platform, each other will not be able to see each other, but they can sense each other's position, but they cannot communicate. This is also to prevent someone from harassing each other.
"Yes, I remember, silly brother."
Qiao Ya's long eyelashes trembled slightly, and a smile spread across her pretty face. Sean was very well prepared for her.
The people who came out of the Tianlang Martial Arts Hall were two young men from the ninth level of the Juyuan Realm who were participating in the competition for quotas. When they saw Sean, they all came up to him with fists in their hands to say hello.
Sean asked casually: "Do you have any preparations?"
When the two teenagers heard this, their faces turned slightly red and they looked embarrassed: "This..."
In the eyes of this young man who can easily take out the best Yuan liquid, such ordinary things in their hands, do they count as preparation?
"Yeah!"
Sean nodded slightly, threw out two jade bottles, and then said: "Don't go up too fast."
Speaking of which, it's pretty good.
After all, Sean only relied on some speculations to avoid misleading others.
"Thank you, thank you little brother."
